name: Fluid Theory
body:
You have learned how to change the properties of your weapon each time you shape them.

Benefit(s): When you shape a veil with the Enhanced descriptor with at least a +2 weapon bonus, you may change the configuration of enhancement bonuses and weapon special properties of that veil. For example, if you shape a veil with the Enhanced descriptor that is a +1 flaming, you may change the enhancement bonuses for that veil to a +1 frost, a +2, a +1 keen, and so forth.

Special: If you possess the Unified Theory feat, you may change the Enhanced veil separately from one another, allowing them to possess different enhancement bonuses and weapon special properties.
